component.name: Rust DICOM Station
component.summary: Medical imaging and radiotherapy research workstation

description.p: RDS (Rust DICOM Station) is open-source software for medical imaging and radiotherapy research, analysis and QA, written entirely in Rust. It loads complete radiotherapy studies (CT, MR and PET series, RTSTRUCT, RTDOSE, photon and ion RTPLAN, DICOM SEG, planar images, spatial and deformable registrations, and treatment records) into one environment for viewing, comparison and quantitative analysis.

ul.li: Linked axial, sagittal and coronal views, dual-dataset comparison, dose colorwash and isodose lines, 3D surfaces
Rigid and deformable image registration, structure propagation, digitally reconstructed radiographs
Dose-volume histograms with metrics and protocol constraints, and 4D motion analysis with ITV generation
Contour drawing and editing, boolean operations and margins, and AI-assisted segmentation with TotalSegmentator, SegVol and MedSAM2 re-implemented in Rust and accelerated through Vulkan
A local patient archive, DICOM editing, anonymization and export
An MCP server, so an AI assistant can drive the same tools headlessly

description.p: Model weights are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use, at your request, and are stored in the application's own data folder.
Research software: not a medical device, neither CE-marked nor FDA-cleared, and not for clinical decision-making.
